Change c0421. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. IV; 1831 Ch. XXI.

Context before (unchanged): I was unable to pursue the train of thought; a thousand feelings pressed upon me, and I wept bitterly.

1818 text: Ever since my recovery from the fever I had been in the custom of taking every night a small quantity of laudanum; for it was by means of this drug only that I was enabled to gain the rest necessary for the preservation of life. Oppressed by the recollection of my various misfortunes, I now took a double dose, and soon slept profoundly.

1831 text: Ever since my recovery from the fever, I had been in the custom of taking every night a small quantity of laudanum; for it was by means of this drug only that I was enabled to gain the rest necessary for the preservation of life. Oppressed by the recollection of my various misfortunes, I now swallowed double my usual quantity, and soon slept profoundly.

Diff: Ever since my recovery from the fever {+,+} I had been in the custom of taking every night a small quantity of laudanum; for it was by means of this drug only that I was enabled to gain the rest necessary for the preservation of life. Oppressed by the recollection of my various misfortunes, I now [-took a-] {+swallowed+} double [-dose-] {+my usual quantity+} , and soon slept profoundly.

Context after (unchanged): But sleep did not afford me respite from thought and misery; my dreams presented a thousand objects that scared me.

result.rationale: Replaces "took a double dose" with "swallowed double my usual quantity", a rephrasing that keeps the same act and meaning; the explicit reference to his usual quantity adds slight elaboration of his habit.
